race_context: Warrick County School Corporation's boundaries are those of Warrick County, and its high schools are Boonville, Castle (Newburgh) and Tecumseh (Lynnville) {wiki_wcsc}. Wikipedia gives enrollment as 9,647 students, an undated figure {wiki_wcsc}; a current count was not found in fetched sources.

Dr. Abbie Redmon is superintendent {wcsc_admin}; the board unanimously chose her in March 2023 to succeed Todd Lambert, making her the district's first woman superintendent, after she served as its director of learning and earlier as a teacher, counselor and principal there {wnin_redmon}.

The board has seven members: President Lynda Glover, Vice President Jeffrey Baker, Secretary Jordan Aigner and members Jane Wilhelmus, Andrew Skinner, Eric Franz and Tim Mosbey {wcsc_board}. It meets the second and fourth Mondays of each month at 7 p.m. {wcsc_board}

Seats on the 2026 ballot: although the state list shows 'vote for 1', VOTE411 lists the race as 'Choose 4' {vote411_wr}, and The Ballot Brief reports that voters choose four, the top four finishers win, and the four sitting members filed unopposed while Glover, Skinner and Mosbey are not up this year {ballotbrief_wr}. All four incumbents (Baker, Wilhelmus, Aigner and Franz) are running, so all four would be reelected {ballotbrief_wr}{vote411_wr}.
Filing: Wilhelmus filed June 2, Franz June 12 (Republican), Baker June 17 and Aigner June 18 (Republican), 2026; Baker and Wilhelmus listed no party {inc_list}.

Budget: the board held a work session Aug. 24, 2026 to review proposed budget estimates and scheduled official adoption of the 2027 budget, capital projects fund plan and bus replacement plan for Sept. 28, 2026 {wcsc_ws0824}{wcsc_ag0928}. No statement from the district on the effect of 2025's Senate Enrolled Act 1 property tax changes was found in fetched sources.
Teacher contract: the board scheduled a public meeting for Oct. 21, 2026 to discuss the terms of a tentative 2026-27 agreement with the WCSC Teachers Association {wcsc_ta}{wcsc_ag1021}.

Other 2026 board business included a closed-session school safety plan presentation (Sept. 28), approval of 2026-27 school improvement plans (Sept. 28 agenda) and superintendent evaluation sessions in May and June {wcsc_ex0928}{wcsc_ag0928}{wcsc_ex0526}{wcsc_ex0622}.
Forums: VOTE411 did not send questionnaires because the race is not competitive, and no candidate forum was found {vote411_wr}.
